Real late repository rejection reads committed expiry and hydrates ended durable fields. The timer independently queues expiry after existing writes; rejected draft text is never described as saved.

Post-paper review is separately submitted after ended, nonabandoned, six complete physical wine records and required comparisons. Partial/abandoned records remain inspectable but cannot grant reviewed-paper participation.

Load preserves pre-current history on pointer failure and refreshes it after current may commit expiry. Reload respects its explicit success boolean and does not mask repeated pointer error. Both concrete recovery cases are covered by real-SQL widget tests.

Retired controllers are disposed after selection-remount frame, then remaining controllers on route disposal; same-paper hydration resets from durable snapshot. Outer non-idle depth-zero user scrolling blurs; nested prose scroll and programmatic caret preserve focus.
